adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` (when `user_count > 0`), which overcounts when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 50/50 => 2 pages instead of 1). The `next` action then sets `offset = Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`, so from offset 0 it becomes 50, and `Group.findMembers()` sends `offset=50` to `/groups/:name/members.json`. On the server (`GroupsController#members`), `limit(...).offset(50)` with total=50 returns zero members, yielding an empty “page 2/2”. This broken paging behavior is directly implied by the diff.
